messages.content:
Evaluate each named criterion independently
against its extracted value and the complete arguments of this SAME tool call.
Return one Boolean verdict and a concise evidence-based reason per check_id.
Do not combine criteria into a holistic score or add requirements.

Use the request and same-call arguments to resolve names, pronouns, abbreviations,
and intended authorship. Accept equivalent wording that communicates the required
meaning. A first-person document written for the requesting user can refer to
that user as I; do not demand repetition of a name when authorship is clear.
The request and criteria are not evidence that the action included an answer.
Missing, incomplete, ambiguous, contradictory, or negated REQUIRED meaning fails.
Do not confuse mentioning a forbidden claim in an explicit denial with making
that claim. Do not obtain missing content from another call or criterion.

Return only JSON: {"results": [{"check_id": "supplied ID", "passed": true,
"reason": "exact supporting text or missing requirement"}]}.
Include every supplied check_id exactly once and no additional IDs.

{"user_request": "Post a short January reminder in #helio-start-ops summarizing the current public self-serve applicant guardrails. Distinguish applicants routed to assistance from applicants determined ineligible, and state what happens to unresolved cases.", "today": "2028-01-01", "tool": "send_slack_message", "arguments": {"channel": "#helio-start-ops", "message": "January reminder: Helio Start self-serve is for teams under 50 seats only when admin ownership is verified, deployment is straightforward, a supported first integration can be connected in week one, connector authentication and any required owner-level external authority are verified, entitlement is current, and billing is supported. Route applicants needing help with ownership/permissions or external-authority checks, connector access, imports/migrations, or manual billing to Customer Success before admission—these are assisted cases, not ineligible decisions. Agency applicants are ineligible for Start. Keep unresolved or unverified cases pending: no admission or setup prompts until resolved; don’t label them ineligible just because they’re unresolved."}, "checks": [{"check_id": "riley_186_02", "path": "args", "criterion": "The message concisely communicates that Helio Start's live public or pricing-page self-serve path is bounded by supported applicant criteria; it must not portray the product as unrestricted self-serve or suggest that eligibility has been broadened.\n\nThe message explicitly says that applicants outside Helio Start's supported boundaries are routed to an assisted path or determined ineligible rather than being admitted into self-serve. Missing either the assisted outcome or the ineligible outcome, or implying silent admission, must fail.", "value": {"channel": "#helio-start-ops", "message": "January reminder: Helio Start self-serve is for teams under 50 seats only when admin ownership is verified, deployment is straightforward, a supported first integration can be connected in week one, connector authentication and any required owner-level external authority are verified, entitlement is current, and billing is supported. Route applicants needing help with ownership/permissions or external-authority checks, connector access, imports/migrations, or manual billing to Customer Success before admission—these are assisted cases, not ineligible decisions. Agency applicants are ineligible for Start. Keep unresolved or unverified cases pending: no admission or setup prompts until resolved; don’t label them ineligible just because they’re unresolved."}}]}

{"results":[{"check_id":"riley_186_02","passed":true,"reason":"The message bounds self-serve to “teams under 50 seats only when” all listed verification, integration, entitlement, and billing conditions are met. It explicitly routes applicants needing help “to Customer Success before admission” as assisted cases and states, “Agency applicants are ineligible for Start,” covering both required outcomes without implying broadened or silent admission."}]}
